title: K-injective total right derived functors preserve scalar linearity
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with $R$-linear structures [def-weil-linear-category]. Work in universes where their unbounded derived categories exist [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the induced linear structures and linear localization functors of [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Suppose every complex of $\mathcal A$ admits a quasi-isomorphism to a K-injective complex, meaning one to which every map from an acyclic complex is chain homotopic to zero. Let $U:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an additive $R$-linear functor [def-weil-linear-functor], and let $U_K:K(\mathcal A)\to K(\mathcal B)$ be its termwise functor on complexes modulo chain homotopy. Let $(RU,\eta)$ be the total right derived functor of $Q_{\mathcal B}U_K$ as defined in [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], with its canonical computation on K-injective complexes.

Then $RU:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ is additive and $R$-linear:
$$RU(h+h')=RU(h)+RU(h'),\qquad RU(ah)=aRU(h)$$
for parallel derived morphisms $h,h'$ and $a\in R$. More precisely, choose any K-injective representatives $I_M,I_N$ and isomorphisms $q_M:M\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{\mathcal A}I_M$, $q_N:N\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{\mathcal A}I_N$. Write
$$c_M=\eta_{I_M}^{-1}RU(q_M):RU(M)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{\mathcal B}U_K(I_M),$$
and similarly for $c_N$. For the unique homotopy class $\bar h:I_M\to I_N$ with $Q_{\mathcal A}(\bar h)=q_Nh q_M^{-1}$, one has
$$c_N RU(h)c_M^{-1}=Q_{\mathcal B}(U_K(\bar h)).$$
These conclusions require neither exactness of $U$ nor an additive or scalar-linear choice of resolutions.

proof.text: On cochain maps put $(f+g)^r=f^r+g^r$ and $(af)^r=af^r$. Bilinearity of composition makes these chain maps. If $f-g=ds+sd$, then $a(f-g)=d(as)+(as)d$; sums of such identities give the corresponding assertion for addition. Thus the operations descend to homotopy classes. Applying $U$ to $f-g=ds+sd$ gives $U(f)-U(g)=U(d)U(s)+U(s)U(d)$ by additivity and functoriality. Consequently $U_K$ is well defined. Its componentwise formulas are $U_K([f]+[g])=U_K([f])+U_K([g])$ and $U_K(a[f])=aU_K([f])$, by the assumed linearity of $U$.

source.place: Tags 09MJ (definition-linear-category), 09MK (definition-functor-linear-categories); agent calculation with the chain-homotopy equation

proof.text: The cited derived-linearity statement says that localization of cochain maps is $R$-linear in both categories. Each homotopy class is represented by a cochain map, and its image under $Q_{\mathcal A}$ or $Q_{\mathcal B}$ is the image of that map under cochain localization. Applying that statement to representatives gives $Q([f]+[g])=Q([f])+Q([g])$ and $Q(a[f])=aQ([f])$. Combined with Step 1, $T=Q_{\mathcal B}\circ U_K$ is therefore $R$-linear on homotopy morphisms.

proof.text: Every derived object has a representative complex, because the derived category is the localization of complexes. Resolve that complex using the hypothesis to obtain an isomorphism to the image of a K-injective. Now fix any $I_M,I_N,q_M,q_N$ as in the statement. The cited K-injective Hom comparison, applied with source $I_M$ and target $I_N$, gives a bijection $L:\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(I_M,I_N)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(Q_{\mathcal A}I_M,Q_{\mathcal A}I_N)$, $g\mapsto Q_{\mathcal A}(g)$. It is $R$-linear by Step 2. Define $\bar h=L^{-1}(q_Nh q_M^{-1})$. Bilinearity gives $q_N(h+h\prime)q_M^{-1}=q_Nh q_M^{-1}+q_Nh\prime q_M^{-1}$ and $q_N(ah)q_M^{-1}=a(q_Nh q_M^{-1})$. Applying $L$ and its injectivity yields $\overline{h+h\prime}=\bar h+\bar h\prime$ and $\overline{ah}=a\bar h$. Thus the unique lift is linear for these fixed representatives.

proof.text:
The derived-functor unit is natural and its components at K-injectives are isomorphisms. Hence the displayed $c_M,c_N$ are isomorphisms. Naturality at $\bar h$ reads $RU(Q_{\mathcal A}\bar h)\,\eta_{I_M}=\eta_{I_N}\,T(\bar h)$. Substitute the definitions and use functoriality and the lift equation to obtain
$$c_N RU(h)c_M^{-1}=\eta_{I_N}^{-1}RU(q_N h q_M^{-1})\eta_{I_M}=\eta_{I_N}^{-1}RU(Q_{\mathcal A}\bar h)\eta_{I_M}=T(\bar h).$$
This proves the representative formula for every choice in the statement.

source.place: Tags 070Y (lemma-K-injective-defined), 070K (lemma-enough-K-injectives-implies); agent naturality calculation using the unit specified in def-sfb-right-derived-functor

proof.text:
Keep $q_M,q_N,I_M,I_N$ fixed for the parallel maps $h,h\prime$. Steps 2--4 give
$$c_N RU(h+h\prime)c_M^{-1}=T(\bar h+\bar h\prime)=T(\bar h)+T(\bar h\prime)=c_N\bigl(RU(h)+RU(h\prime)\bigr)c_M^{-1},$$
and
$$c_N RU(ah)c_M^{-1}=T(a\bar h)=aT(\bar h)=c_N\bigl(aRU(h)\bigr)c_M^{-1}.$$
The last equality in each line is bilinearity of composition in $D(\mathcal B)$. Cancel $c_N$ and $c_M^{-1}$ to get both asserted identities, which are exactly the requirements for an $R$-linear functor. The choices were fixed only while comparing morphisms; no functorial, additive or linear choice of resolutions was used. Only the additivity of $U$, its scalar linearity, and the hypothesized K-injective computation entered.

The delivery adds only proof, proof_deps, proof_origin, split_report and searches, with no new nodes. The item is not in route-pivot-dropped, has no repair note and cites no SGA. Sources checked: derived.tex 070I lemma-K-injective (1)<=>(3) at l.9632, 070Y and 070K; dga.tex 09MJ and 09MK. Step 1: sums, scalar multiples and homotopies descend to K(A), and U_K is well defined and linear without exactness. Step 2: linearity of Q on cochain maps (lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category) passes to K(A) through representatives, so T=Q_B U_K is linear. Step 3: the unbounded K-injective Hom bijection (lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived) is linear, so its inverse lift is additive and homogeneous. Step 4: I verified the directions of the maps: c_M=eta^{-1}RU(q_M), and naturality of the unit at the lift (def-sfb-right-derived-functor) gives c_N RU(h) c_M^{-1}=T(lift). Step 5: cancelling the isomorphisms gives linearity, with no functorial choice of resolutions. I tested a=0, R=0, U=id and non-exact U=lim (the parent's use); none needs exactness or boundedness. The parent lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence supplies every hypothesis. A whole-DAG duplicate scan found no general duplicate. Advisory: lem-sf-kinjective-derived-map-computation states the same formula, but only for chain resolutions; the item's version takes arbitrary isomorphisms in D, so re-deriving it in two lines in Step 4 is acceptable.
